description: This file contains the implementation of the RazorShapeTemplateViewEngine class, which is responsible for rendering Razor views within the OrchardCore Display Management system. It handles view lookup, rendering to string or HTML content, and integrates with ASP.NET Core MVC infrastructure.

classes.name: RazorShapeTemplateViewEngine
classes.description: A view engine implementation for rendering Razor templates within OrchardCore, supporting view lookup, rendering to string or HTML content, and extension points for view extensions.

methods.name: RazorShapeTemplateViewEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the view engine.

methods.name: TemplateFileExtensions
methods.description: Property returning supported Razor view file extensions.

methods.name: RenderAsync
methods.description: Renders a Razor view asynchronously given a relative path and display context.

methods.name: RenderRazorViewAsync
methods.description: Internal method to render a Razor view to HTML content asynchronously.

methods.name: RenderViewToStringAsync
methods.description: Converts a view into a string by rendering it with a given model and view engine.

methods.name: FindView
methods.description: Locates a view using the view engine, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: MakeHtmlHelper
methods.description: Creates or contextualizes an IHtmlHelper instance for rendering partial views.
